mapper.sql: q.id, q.health_center_id, q.visit_id, q.service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, q.ticket_number, q.status, v.visit_type, v.visitor_name, v.visitor_phone, q.issued_at, q.called_at, q.started_at, q.completed_at, q.hold_at
mapper.select: WITH next_ticket AS ( INSERT INTO queue_ticket_counters ( health_center_id, service_type_id, issued_date, last_ticket_number, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{healthCenterId}, #{serviceTypeId}, CURRENT_DATE, ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(q.ticket_number), 0) + 1 FROM queue_tickets q WHERE q.health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND q.service_type_id = #{serviceTypeId} AND q.issued_at::date = CURRENT_DATE ), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (health_center_id, service_type_id, issued_date) DO UPDATE SET last_ticket_number = queue_ticket_counters.last_ticket_number + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING last_ticket_number ) INSERT INTO queue_tickets ( health_center_id, visit_id, service_type_id, ticket_number, status, issued_at, created_at ) SELECT #{healthCenterId}, #{visitId}, #{serviceTypeId}, next_ticket.last_ticket_number, 'WAITING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM next_ticket RETURNING id, ticket_number, status

SELECT
FROM queue_tickets q INNER JOIN visits v ON v.id = q.visit_id INNER JOIN service_types st ON st.id = q.service_type_id WHERE q.id = #{queueTicketId}
mapper.update: UPDATE queue_tickets SET status = 'CALLED', called_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{queueTicketId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'HOLD')
UPDATE queue_tickets SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{queueTicketId} AND status = 'CALLED'
UPDATE queue_tickets SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{queueTicketId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE queue_tickets SET status = 'HOLD', hold_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{queueTicketId} AND status = 'CALLED'
UPDATE queue_tickets SET status = 'NO_SHOW', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{queueTicketId} AND status = 'HOLD'
UPDATE queue_tickets SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{queueTicketId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'CALLED', 'HOLD')
UPDATE visits v SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM queue_tickets q WHERE q.visit_id = v.id AND q.id = #{queueTicketId}
